These pages hold the information architecture for a later, cited history. They are **not** a finished narrative.

The commissioning brief suggested this working lineage so later evidence has a place to land:

**institutional or agency care → disability-led independent-living experiments → Creekview → Enhanced Consumer Participation Model (ECPM) → direct individualized funding → CSIL design and pilot → a province-wide program.**

That sentence is a **research proposition**. Catalogue records now exist for several of the dates; the lineage itself is still not written as history.

Working dates to accommodate:

| Working date | Placeholder | Status on this site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early 1980s | Independent-living / community-living advocacy in British Columbia | Open question |
| c. 1985 | Creekview | Opening attested by later/near-primary sources; 1984–86 Hansard inspected |
| c. 1987 | Creekview evaluation | Evaluation attested (Mattinson & Rompf; Haw); report copy not held; Ryan authorship unconfirmed |
| c. 1990 | ECPM material and *Keys on Freedom* | 1990 ECPM manual independently cited; *Keys on Freedom* still unconfirmed |
| c. 1993 | CSIL design / authorization | Contested with 1994 |
| c. 1994 | CSIL pilot; possible ECPM training revision | Contested with 1993; 1994 revision unfound |
| c. 1995 | Province-wide availability | Later official chronology (Ombudsperson 2012); 1995 HEU still says “pilot” |

Use the [timeline](../timeline.qmd) for the same propositions in date order, and [sources](../sources/index.qmd) for catalogue records.
